- Day13 | p18-19: fill in the following bar graph: 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 2.5
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "A blank ggplot canvas with quiz2 topics on the y-axis and amount of time I need to dedicate to this topic on the x-axis"
#| echo: false


library(tidyverse)

topics <- c(
  "dplyr verbs",
  "group_by",
  "Joins and bind_rows",
  "pivot_longer and pivot_wider",
  "Dates and times",
  "Factors",
  "Importing data"
)

ggplot(tibble(topic = factor(topics, levels = rev(topics))),
       aes(x = 0, y = topic)) +
  geom_blank() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10),
                     breaks = c(0, 10),
                     labels = c("none", "a lot")) +
  labs(x = "Amount of time I need to dedicate to this topic",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
